record.paper_title: Some open problems on the classical function space L1
record.context_brief: stability of narrow operators under addition
record.original_question: For an arbitrary Banach space X, is the sum of two narrow operators from L1[0,1] to X again a narrow operator?

evidence.quote: Problem 18. ([59]) For each Banach space X , is the sum of two narrow operators from L1 to X also narrow?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\Omega,\Sigma,\mu)$ be a non-atomic finite measure space (for concreteness, take $[0,1]$ with Lebesgue measure) and let $L_1 = L_1[0,1]$. For a Banach space $X$, a bounded linear operator $T: L_1 \to X$ is called narrow if for every measurable set $A \subseteq [0,1]$ and every $\varepsilon > 0$ there exists a function $x \in L_1$ of the form $x = \mathbf{1}_B - \mathbf{1}_{A\setminus B}$ (a sign on $A$, i.e. $|x| = \mathbf{1}_A$ and $\int_A x\,d\mu = 0$) such that $\|T x\| < \varepsilon$.

Question: Is it true that for every Banach space $X$ and every pair of narrow operators $T_1, T_2: L_1[0,1] \to X$, the sum $T_1 + T_2$ is again a narrow operator?
artifact.status_search_result: The question has been answered in the negative. A theorem of V. Mykhaylyuk and M. Popov (J. Math. Anal. Appl. 404 (2013), 554–561, "On sums of narrow operators on Köthe function spaces") shows that for every Köthe Banach space E on [0,1] — in particular for E = L_1[0,1] — there exist a Banach space X and two narrow operators from E to X whose sum is not narrow. Thus the sum-of-two-narrow-operators property of L_1 does not extend to arbitrary Banach-space-valued operators.

status_evidence.title: On sums of narrow and compact operators (Popov, Positivity 2019)
status_evidence.snippet: A result of Mykhaylyuk and the second named author asserts that, for every Köthe Banach space E on [0,1], there exist a Banach space X and narrow operators from E to X with nonnarrow sum.
status_evidence.claim: For every Köthe Banach space E on [0,1] (including L_1) there exist narrow operators E → X whose sum is not narrow, resolving the question negatively.

status_evidence.title: Narrow operators (a survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing sums of narrow operators on function spaces and the Mykhaylyuk–Popov counterexample.
status_evidence.claim: Survey confirms existence of Banach space X and narrow operators from L_1 to X with non-narrow sum.
